this timestamp carries value="3800000000" and ConvertAIXMLToVI discards it - the export reads back value="" with errorCode 0 throughout. There is no non-empty timestamp literal AIXML can express, so there is nothing to correct it to. It matters because a generated round-trip test authors the written value and the expected value in the same document: both vanish, and the assertion then compares empty with empty and PASSES while pinning nothing.

this Event Structure has a ' Timeout ' frame, but AIXML has no way to wire the structure's eventTimeOut terminal: a <Tunnel> here becomes an ordinary tunnel and the terminal stays unwired, so the frame NEVER fires and the loop waits forever (measured: Timeouts=0 over 2.2 s with 500 ms asked for). Wire the timeout by hand in the IDE, or pace the loop with a Wait (ms) / Wait on Notification and poll instead. The event frames themselves are fine.
